set.body:
Goal: cover the declared grammar and device/configuration envelope with licensed, privacy-safe evidence.

Acceptance criteria:
- Corpus separates hand-computable synthetic ASC, redistributable deidentified real captures, and private real-device EDF/ASC pairs.
- Manifest records fixture id, license/privacy disposition, hardware/firmware when known, rate, eye mode, tracking mode, coordinate mode, converter executable digest/version, exact options, EDF digest when permitted, ASC digest, and expected capabilities.
- Pairwise coverage spans all supported matrix dimensions; uncovered cells remain explicitly unvalidated.
- At minimum the corpus exercises left, right, binocular, remote/head-fixed, multiple rates, optional columns, missingness, native events, message offsets, multiple blocks, and corrupted/failsafe cases where available.
- Public CI never downloads private gaze data; private fixtures are addressed by digest and produce publishable aggregate evidence.
- Fixture acquisition and redistribution permissions are documented before data enters the repository.
- Corpus changes are reviewable and versioned independently from parser implementation.
set.title: Assemble the EyeLink conformance corpus and fixture manifest
